target.effect_scale: log-log OLS PM10 elasticity; transformed to outcome ratio for doubling PM10 exceedance days

substitutions.published: Unidentified random sample of 55 provincial-capital cities
substitutions.reason: The article does not supply the sampled-city roster or selection seed.

substitutions.reanalysis: Civil Protection province cumulative confirmed-case counts
substitutions.reason: The public official archive provides province, rather than municipal/capital, series.

substitutions.published: Author's PM10-or-ozone city exceedance series (Table 6 labels PM10)
substitutions.reanalysis: Nearest-station EEA PM10 daily-max days >50 ug/m3 in 2018
substitutions.reason: Required independent public exposure source; PM10 follows the principal-table wording.

substitutions.reanalysis: Istat NUTS3 2019 population divided by GISCO NUTS3 area
substitutions.reason: Article does not provide city-level covariate values or sample roster.

coverage.notes: 64 nearest-station assignments were available; 35 had positive PM10 exceedance counts; 18 had all log-model inputs.

effect.contrast: Primary 2020-03-17 model: fitted case ratio for doubling 2018 PM10 exceedance days, exp(beta_PM10*ln(2)); native log-log beta=-0.5561675 (95% CI -1.6260748, 0.5137398).

blockers: The article's 55-city sample cannot be reconstructed because its roster and selection procedure are not supplied.
The fitted panel uses province outcomes and province density, not city values.
Only 18 complete positive-exposure records support the log-log model.
